# Xplania

> Web app that helps people going abroad (Erasmus, internship, exchange, trip) organise their departure ahead of time, without hassle: budget, visa, packing and cultural codes in one place. French and English. Free during the beta.

Xplania brings together four preparation tools around a single trip: a budget guide, a visa & paperwork guide, a smart packing list and a cultural immersion guide. A dashboard shows progress in each tool before departure.

## Pages

- [Intro](/): Overview of the 4 preparation steps (entry point).
- [Home](/home): Product overview, the 4 tools, FAQ and signup.
- [Budget guide](/guide-budget): Realistic budget for the stay in 3 scenarios, planned-expense tracking and saving tips.
- [Visa & paperwork guide](/guide-visa): Visa formalities, vaccines and safety advice synthesized from official sources (France Diplomatie, Institut Pasteur, WHO), with a document checklist.
- [Culture guide](/guide-culture): Cultural codes of the destination country (dress, food etiquette, gestures, greetings), real-life situations and mini-quiz.
- [Offers](/offres): 10 free tries per tool each month, then the Admin pack (budget, visa, packing) or the Intercultural pack.
- [About](/a-propos): Why Xplania exists and who builds it.
- [Trust & security](/securite): How Xplania protects user data and security contact.
